Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

We will continue with module six on corrosion chemistry and we will talk about different types of electrochemical corrosion and today's discussion will be on waterline corrosion and petting corrosion.

Key details

  • Last class we discussed about differential aeration corrosion where an oxygen concentration cell was getting formed due to difference in the concentration of oxygen to which the metal surface is exposed.
  • This happens when a metal is half immersed in water.
  • And when this happens we call it as waterline corrosion.
  • Whereas at the cathode because there is more oxygen.
  • And if you remember electrochemical theory of corrosion, I said that the.
  • Products which are formed at the anode and cathode, the ions which are formed at the anode and cathode move towards each other and in between the anode and cathode we get the formation of the corrosion product.
  • The corrosion product will deposit in between the anode and cathode.
  • And that's exactly what happens here.
  • A brown line on the surface of the ship.
  • Many of you would have noticed this, or there will be a brown line on the surface of the ship, and where do you see it?
  • Wherever the water line.
  • Brown line and what is that brown line on the surface?
  • It is due to the corrosion product.
  • they move towards each other and somewhere in between they will get deposited and that is happening at the water level.
  • Which is formed just below the waterline, and because of this, this type of corrosion is referred to as waterline corrosion.
  • So basically it is differential aeration, but because it is happening in the presence of water, especially, it is called waterline correction.
  • Corrosion and the brown line appears at the waterline.
  • What happens here?
  • The part which is inside the inside the water now here again exposed to less oxygen that becomes the anode and the part which is above exposed to more oxygen is going to become the cathodic area and in between we will see a brown line getting.
